messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kw frequency converter.
Our order history for this part shows 400.19 EUR (po:4500011931-10) against 412.74 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014465-10).
Our latest forecast for part:350020 grows +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, volume, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,580 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We acknowledge your volume forecast; however, we are unable to provide a detailed cost breakdown due to strict internal compliance policies. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We can accommodate your request for a 24-month contract duration and 60-day payment terms. Reflecting these terms, we propose a revised unit price of €430.16.

Our current offer stands at a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €430.16 per unit, with a price of €430.16 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
